title: Competitor alerts on live calls: real-time agent assist from an AI listener
alias: real-time agent assist and conversation intelligence
summary: A sales-call demo built to show real-time agent assist: an AI listener rides along on a live call, notices when the customer names a competitor, and posts the alert to your server while the sentence is still being spoken. It never speaks into the call.
scenario: A sales rep is on a call and an alert lands on their screen the moment the customer says a rival's name
